explanation: This is a `rfl` simp lemma. It unfolds `KTheory.K0.ofClassRingHom` to `KTheory.K0.ofClass`, and both are definitions of the library itself (the K₀ of a commutative ring built from `ProjectiveClass R`). Mathlib has no K₀ or `ProjectiveClass` construction, so it has no declaration that could state this. The lemma's content lies entirely in the library's own definitions. I did not search Mathlib, because these constants exist only in this library.
